verdict.rationale: Bill upload with an approval workflow is a fair question for a business payments account, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only payment execution (business payments via API, batch groups of up to 1000 transfers, bulk settlement), with nothing on uploading bills or approval routing before payment. Batch transfers are an adjacent payment feature, not a bill-approval workflow, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can upload bills and route them through an approval workflow before paying vendors
